in_marathi.name: Jaivardhan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of the Earth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jaivardhan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jaivardhan is a name of Lord Vishnu, meaning 'Lord of the Earth'. It is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Jai' (victory) and 'Vardhan' (nourisher). It is believed that this name brings strength, loyalty, and power to the bearer.
